generalNotice.title: General Compliance Statement
generalNotice.content: SeekDrone operates in compliance with international export control regulations, including but not limited to the Wassenaar Arrangement, ITAR, and EAR. Our products are intended for use in approved markets and applications only. All sales are subject to end-user verification and export license requirements where applicable.
